crossRefs.note: Yahweh was with Jehoshaphat, because he walked in the first ways of his father David, and didn’t seek the Baals,
but sought to the God of his father, and walked in his commandments, and not in the ways of Israel.
He walked in all the way of Asa his father. He didn’t turn away from it, doing that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes.…
Asa did that which was good and right in Yahweh his God’s eyes;
Asa did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, as David his father did.
